failure_summary.description: Answers were close in meaning but missed the expected minimal or canonical form, including number, name form, or unnecessary alternatives and labels.
The agent chose an associated detail or classification instead of the clue's requested target or contextual relation.

patch.reasoning: The skill already instructs the agent to give minimal answers, preserve supported grammatical form, use a shorter name when unambiguous, and identify the clue's target rather than an associated entity. It also says not to default to classifying a named work when context implies another relation. These failures therefore reflect rules already present, so duplicating them is not warranted.
